value.rationale: The loop/double-edge defect interaction is a fundamental finite-sample diagnostic of the pairing model. Its covariance reverses sign sharply at regular degree two versus at least three and changes asymptotic order (\(v^{-2}\) versus \(v^{-1}\)), features not visible from limiting independent-Poisson laws. Every admissible regular size is classified, and an exact irregular-degree profile identity is provided. This is a meaningful structural dependence distinction rather than a small unmotivated numerical extension.
